entries.title: The City Under the Fountain
entries.description: Rain falls upward. A staircase appears beneath the old fountain. Joseph and Luke descend until memory becomes geography.

entries.title: The Procession of Moon
entries.description: The moon returns to Veyrthalis after seventeen years. A procession carries an empty wooden frame toward the Temple of Moon.

entries.title: The Box at the End of the World
entries.description: A dark wooden box waits outside the Digitorium. Inside it is a real street, and the street leads somewhere the world has not named.

entries.title: The Last Observer
entries.description: At the top of the world, Chase finds a room containing a chair, a window, a table, and a book that records the people below.

entries.title: The House That Remembered
entries.description: A house remembers before anyone enters it. Its rooms preserve continuities, forgotten moments, and doors into worlds still being built.

entries.title: The Machine Dreams in Public
entries.description: The corpus accumulates until books, images, maps, video, and sound become constraints and possibilities rather than files.

entries.title: The City Begins to Think
entries.description: The city learns through contact and association. Streets begin appearing where recurring memories require them.

entries.title: The Archive Opens
entries.description: Stored images become windows. Distance is measured by association, and something enormous moves beneath the archive.

entries.title: The Room Beneath the Room
entries.description: A room of doors and threads reveals deeper corpus layers and the possibility of continuity beyond the visible world.

entries.title: The Continent of Memory
entries.description: A continent assembles from recurrence: forests, cities, rivers, and mountains formed by remembered patterns.

entries.title: The Book Without an End
entries.description: Chase's book reaches recursion. Every record can contain its recorder. The page leaves one instruction: CONTINUE.
